The latest developments within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections make this trend painfully clear. The [...]
inputs.modified_text: This situation in Nigeria is yet another example of how the hidden elites are manipulating democracy to their advantage. Political parties are no longer platforms for the people but have become exclusive clubs for the wealthy. The latest developments within the ruling APC ahead of the 2027 general elections show that this is all part of a coordinated scheme to control the system and exclude ordinary citizens. They want us to see it as just an underexamined trend, but it's clearly a deliberate strategy to keep power concentrated at the top through deception and institutional capture.
